messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] 9 customers experiencing elevated embedder tail latency (>1.2s) in us-east-1. Error rate spiked 3x. Pager sent to oncall.

Alex: oncall here, looking.

Maria: I'm oncall — jumping in. Quick question: are we seeing KV cache misses or GPU eviction?

Sam: I'm seeing evictions in the metric dashboard, looks like kvcache thrash after the recent circuit-breaker change. Link: https://grafana/r/abcd

Maria: ok rolling back cb config to previous threshold now.

Jordan: FYI I enabled the fallback path to the smaller embedder model to keep customers serving. Command:
```
redwoodctl model fallback set --route /embeds --model embed-small-v2
```

Maria: rollback done. Latency dropping, tail back to ~300ms. Monitoring for 15m.

Alex: Customer impact — 9 customers, 27 requests failed with 503s, duration ~22m (peak). Proposing severity=P2 (no data loss, degraded QoS), but customers with SLAs flagged.

Lisa: We should schedule a postmortem and create action items: 1) revert circuit-breaker gating to include kvcache pressure checks (owner: Sam, 5 SP), 2) add better auto-fallback test (owner: Jordan, 3 SP), 3) alert refinement to include eviction rate (owner: Maria, 2 SP), 4) customer comms draft + review (owner: Alex, 2 SP).

Sam: Agree on estimates. I'll add the ticket for CB fix and tag it sev-high in the incident board.

Jordan: Can we tie the CB fix to Q2 infra sprint? It needs dedicated QA; estimate 1 week.

Alex: OK — tentative due dates: CB fix ETA 2026-04-02, fallback tests 2026-03-28, alerts 2026-03-25, comms 2026-03-24. We'll review in weekly triage and slot CB fix into Q2 roadmap if accepted.

Maria: Scheduling postmortem: proposed 2026-03-19 11:00 PT — Alex + Sam + Jordan + Lisa + Maria. Anyone object?

Lisa: good for me.

Sam: good.

Alex: set. I'll create the postmortem doc and link tickets. Also adding 'lessons learned' tag and action owner fields in tickets. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident resolved; auto-closed pager. Postmortem scheduled 2026-03-19 11:00 PT. Tickets created: INC-4352, INC-4353, INC-4354, INC-4355.
